decisions.reason: As a net price display plugin it still fits the firm's core shop implementation work, but after several years and no recent observed website presence it carries some rationalization risk.
The ERP system interface plugin supports the firm's end-to-end e-commerce and multichannel integration strategy, so it remains strategically useful and comparatively unlikely to be withdrawn.
This price comparison tracking plugin matches the firm's analytics and performance-marketing focus, though overlap within the plugin portfolio keeps withdrawal risk at a moderate level.

Because it is another closely related price comparison tracking plugin in a range that has already seen consolidation, management would likely discontinue it to concentrate resources on stronger core and new development work.
The net price reporting plugin complements the firm's measurable optimization and reporting services, making continued retention more likely than withdrawal.
